title: Every session sends fewer messages: an outbox, owners read their own answers, the roster is read first
why: Your ruling, Oct 26 19:40 CDT ("Yes agreed"), on the 60-an-hour message cap: the fewer-messages rules now sit only in this project's instructions.
note: Draft PR 660 (give the fewer-messages rules one home each), head 319f99a, sent to the build advisor for the batch (Oct 26 20:50 CDT). Homes: the questions-go-to-owner rule and its decision entry, the waiting-page skill (the owning session reads its own answers at each wake; nobody relays), and the project-ops operating model (new "Messages between threads" section: outbox, roster read before sending, no broadcast on a hand-off, send at once only when blocked or asked). No skill named orchestrate exists, so project-ops is that home. The scaffold now writes roadmap/outbox/README.md (red test first). Times in US Central stay a project instruction, not a global rule. Checks green; review one round, clear (builder sonnet, reviewer sonnet). Port: yes; the rules are global. Placed ahead of c53's slot, after c88 and c97 (triage, Oct 27): every thread hits the cap.
